scripts.flush: wp-env run cli wp cache flush && wp-env run cli wp rewrite flush
scripts.db:export: wp-env run cli wp db export /var/www/html/backup.sql && docker cp $(docker ps -qf 'name=wordpress'):/var/www/html/backup.sql ./backup.sql
scripts.db:import: docker cp ./backup.sql $(docker ps -qf 'name=wordpress'):/var/www/html/backup.sql && wp-env run cli wp db import /var/www/html/backup.sql
scripts.db:pull: dotenv -- bash -c 'ssh $SSH_USER@$SSH_HOST "cd $SSH_PATH/../../.. && wp db export -" > backup-prod.sql'
scripts.plugins:list: wp-env run cli wp plugin list --status=active
scripts.plugins:export: wp-env run cli wp plugin list --status=active --field=name > plugins.txt
scripts.plugins:install: cat plugins.txt | xargs -I {} wp-env run cli wp plugin install {} --activate
scripts.plugins:install:prod: dotenv -- bash -c 'cat plugins.txt | xargs -I {} ssh $SSH_USER@$SSH_HOST "cd $SSH_PATH/../../.. && wp plugin install {} --activate"'
